description: Experience seamless language transcription with Otter - your all-in-one solution for effortless audio and video transcription.
download-starting-description: The download will begin shortly. You can then find the installer in your Downloads folder.
support-while-you-wait: While you wait, consider supporting the Otter project to help us grow!
title: Transcribe. on Your Own.
hero-eyebrow: Speech to text for clinical work
post-download-step-open-installer: Open the installer from your Downloads folder.
post-download-step-launch: Launch Otter and drop in an audio or video file.
changelogBetaHint: On the beta channel for now. To get it, turn on Settings → General → Beta updates in the app.
which-mac: Pick the build for your Mac. Not sure? Apple menu → About This Mac shows the chip.
apple-silicon-hint: M1, M2, M3, M4 and newer
modelsTitle: Pick the model for your language
modelsLead: Every model runs on your own computer. Open one in Otter and it installs itself.
modelsNoApp: Open in Otter needs the app on this computer. Or copy the link and paste it into Otter's model settings.
footer-description: Speech to text for clinical work, on your own computer.
hero-title: Tell Otter your terms. It writes them your way.
hero-subtitle: Dictate notes or record a consultation, and Otter turns it into text on your own computer.
point-terms-description: List the drug names, procedures and names you use, and transcription follows them. Works with Whisper models.
point-dictate-description: Press a shortcut and speak; Otter types it into the app you are using.
point-record-description: Record a consultation or drop in a file, and get a transcript with speaker labels.
point-local-description: Transcription happens on your device. Your audio is not uploaded.
